Game Overview

Wounded Summer is a adventure game built around embark on a daring rescue mission as Tecumseh, a skilled young hunter. Master the bow and terrain, outsmart outnumbering foes, and eliminate threats with precision. Use stealth and strategy to save your tribe in this immersive action-adventure set deep in a rich cultural wilderness.
